name: The Amber Debt
summary: Exethanter has an old note pinned under all the others, in his own hand: DO NOT GO BELOW THE VAULT. YOU SEALED IT. YOU DO NOT REMEMBER WHY. THAT IS WHY.

stages.journal: Under all the notes on Exethanter's sleeve there's an old one in his own hand: DO NOT GO BELOW THE VAULT. YOU SEALED IT. YOU DO NOT REMEMBER WHY. THAT IS WHY. He says the vault floor has been warm lately.
stages.hint: Look at the floor of the Amber Temple's vaults for what Exethanter sealed.

stages.journal: A crack in the vault floor weeps warm amber, and something deep in it blinked. Under the slab a stair goes down.
stages.hint: Go down the stair under the vault floor.

stages.journal: The wardens' day-book: a thing all eyes came up from under the mountain while they built the temple. They couldn't kill it; they sang it to sleep in amber, and when the song stopped holding it Exethanter gave it his memory. Every time he remembers anything, it wakes a little more.
objectives: Optional: turn the hall's mirrors toward its chamber
stages.hint: Under the vaults, use the wardens' book: turn the mirrors, learn their lullaby, then put out the Eye Below.

stages.journal: The Eye Below is dead in its broken amber.
stages.hint: Search the heap of things the Eye collected, under the vaults.

stages.journal: The Eye Below is dead, and the things its dreams fetched it for a thousand years are ours, among them a shield the wardens made against it. Exethanter can forget it in peace now, or remember. Either way it won't matter.
